name: Question 20
problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 5 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 6 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -8 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 4\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 5 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 6 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -8 \\ 2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 5{x}_{1} \\ -2{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ 6{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-{x}_{3} \\ -8{x}_{3} \\ 2{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 4\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} \\ 5{x}_{1}+6{x}_{2}-8{x}_{3} \\ -2{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=2 \\ 5{x}_{1}+6{x}_{2}-8{x}_{3}=-3 \\ -2{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=4\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 5 & 6 & -8 & -3 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & 4\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 5 & 6 & -8 & -3 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-5){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -13 \\ -2 & -2 & 2 & 4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & -1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & -13 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 8\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=2 \\ {x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=-13 \\ 0=8.\end{aligned}
$$

However, the final equation $0=8$  gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.

If x1a1+x2a2+x3a3=b, then we have

x1[15−2]+x2[16−2]+x3[−1−82]=[2−34][x15x1−2x1]+[x26x2−2x2]+[−x3−8x32x3]=[2−34][x1+x2−x35x1+6x2−8x3−2x1−2x2+2x3]=[2−34].

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

{x1+x2−x3=25x1+6x2−8x3=−3−2x1−2x2+2x3=4

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

M=[11−1256−8−3−2−224].

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

M=[11−1256−8−3−2−224]R2:=R2+(−5)R1∼[11−1201−3−13−2−224]R3:=R3+2R1∼[11−1201−3−130008].

The system is now {x1+x2−x3=2x2−3x3=−130=8.

However, the final equation 0=8 gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.
